?- self(Self),
   spawn(
       ( price(widget, Price),
         Self ! discounted_price(Price)
       ),
       _,
       [ src_text("
             price(Item, Price) :-
                 list_price(Item, ListPrice),
                 Price is ListPrice * 0.9.
         ")
       ]
   ),
   receive({discounted_price(Price) -> true}).

?- self(Self),
   spawn(
       ( findall(Item-Price,
                 list_price(Item, Price),
                 Prices),
         Self ! private_prices(Prices)
       ),
       _,
       [
        src_text("list_price(widget, 80).")
       ]
   ),
   receive({private_prices(Prices) -> true}).
